## Functions

### `countsFromFacet`

Per-node gene counts from a Solr facet array `[id, count, id, count, …]`,
summed up the tree so collapsed clades show their subtree total. With
`key: 'nodeId'` (default) facet ids are matched against leaf node ids and
the result equals gramene-search's `computeGeneCounts(tree, facet)`
exactly; with `key: 'taxonomyId'` they are matched against
`String(leaf.taxonomyId)` instead, which is what a gene tree needs.
Origin: gramene-search `taxTree/countsZone.js:20-53` (`computeGeneCounts`).

```ts
function countsFromFacet(tree: Tree, facet: ReadonlyArray<string | number> | undefined, key?: 'nodeId' | 'taxonomyId'): Record<NodeId, number>;
```

### `geneIdByLeafNodeId`

The inverse of `leafNodeIdByGeneId`: leaf node id → `geneId`, for every
leaf with a gene id (the hover readout map).
Origin: gramene-search `details/exprAttrsZone.js:34-38` (`nodeGene`).

```ts
function geneIdByLeafNodeId(tree: Tree): Record<NodeId, GeneId>;
```

### `joinByLeaf`

Re-key per-gene values by leaf node id. Gene ids with no matching leaf
are dropped from `byNode` and listed in `unmatched` (in input order) —
the original silently skipped such documents.
Origin: gramene-search `details/exprAttrsZone.js:44-54`.

```ts
function joinByLeaf<T>(tree: Tree, byGeneId: Record<GeneId, T>): {
    byNode: Record<NodeId, T>;
    unmatched: GeneId[];
};
```

### `joinByTaxon`

Re-key per-taxon values by node id. Every node carrying a `taxonomyId`
(leaf or internal — a taxonomy tree has one per node, a gene tree one
per leaf) receives the value stored under `String(taxonomyId)`, so one
species' value fans out to all of its genes. Keys matching no node are
listed in `unmatched` (in input order). Both sides are compared as
strings, so numeric and string taxon ids interoperate.

```ts
function joinByTaxon<T>(tree: Tree, byTaxonId: Record<string, T>): {
    byNode: Record<NodeId, T>;
    unmatched: string[];
};
```

### `leafNodeIdByGeneId`

Map from `geneId` to leaf node id for every leaf that carries a gene id
(later leaves win on duplicate gene ids, as in the original). This is the
`nodeOf` map every gramene-search zone builds to key per-gene documents
by row.
Origin: gramene-search `details/exprAttrsZone.js:34-38` (`nodeOf`).

```ts
function leafNodeIdByGeneId(tree: Tree): Record<GeneId, NodeId>;
```

### `maxByNode`

Maximum per-leaf number over each subtree: leaves get `leafValues[id] || 0`,
internal nodes the max over their children (0 when none) — the value a
collapsed row should show for a "peak" style column.

```ts
function maxByNode(tree: Tree, leafValues: Record<NodeId, number>): Record<NodeId, number>;
```

### `rowFlags`

Flags for one visible row from the chassis's hover/selection state.
`hoveredSubtreeIds` normally contains the hovered node itself, so an
exactly-hovered row has both hover flags set.
Origin: gramene-search `taxTree/countsZone.js:84-88` (the `rowHighlight`
call arguments).

```ts
function rowFlags(row: VisibleRow, s: {
    hoveredNodeId: NodeId | null;
    hoveredSubtreeIds: ReadonlySet<NodeId>;
    selectedNodeId: NodeId | null;
}): RowFlags;
```

### `rowsInRange`

The rows inside the viewer's virtualised window:
`rows.slice(range.startIndex, range.endIndex)`.
Origin: gramene-search `taxTree/countsZone.js:78`.

```ts
function rowsInRange(rows: readonly VisibleRow[], range: RowRange): VisibleRow[];
```

### `rowsTotalHeight`

Total pixel height of a row list: `last.y + last.height`, 0 when empty.
Zones size their scroll body to this.
Origin: gramene-search `taxTree/countsZone.js:74-76` (`totalHeight`).

```ts
function rowsTotalHeight(rows: readonly VisibleRow[]): number;
```

### `sumByNode`

Sum per-leaf numbers up the tree (`sumLeafCounts` under its zone-facing
name): leaves get `leafValues[id] || 0`, internal nodes the sum over
their children.

```ts
function sumByNode(tree: Tree, leafValues: Record<NodeId, number>): Record<NodeId, number>;
```

## Interfaces

### `RowFlags`

Per-row highlight flags, in the precedence order the viewer's zones
apply them: selected > exact hover > inside the hovered subtree. The
CSS-variable mapping (`rowHighlightBackground`) lives in tbrowse.

```ts
interface RowFlags {
    isSelected: boolean;
    isExactHover: boolean;
    isInHoveredSubtree: boolean;
}
```
